source.text: וְ/חַנָּ֖ה לֹ֣א עָלָ֑תָה כִּֽי אָמְרָ֣ה לְ/אִישָׁ֗/הּ עַ֣ד יִגָּמֵ֤ל הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ וַ/הֲבִאֹתִ֗י/ו וְ/נִרְאָה֙ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/יָ֥שַׁב שָׁ֖ם עַד עוֹלָֽם־־־׃

context.marker_free_english: But Hannah did not go up, for she said to her husband, “Not until the boy is weaned will I bring him, so that he may appear before Yahweh and stay there forever.”

source.text: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הּ֩ אֶלְקָנָ֨ה אִישָׁ֜/הּ עֲשִׂ֧י הַ/טּ֣וֹב בְּ/עֵינַ֗יִ/ךְ שְׁבִי֙ עַד גָּמְלֵ֣/ךְ אֹת֔/וֹ אַ֛ךְ יָקֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶת דְּבָר֑/וֹ וַ/תֵּ֤שֶׁב הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ וַ/תֵּ֣ינֶק אֶת בְּנָ֔/הּ עַד גָּמְלָ֖/הּ אֹתֽ/וֹ־־־־׃

context.marker_free_english: And Elqanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good in your eyes. Stay until you have weaned him; only may Yahweh establish his word.” So the woman stayed and nursed her son until she had weaned him.

source.text: וַ/תַּעֲלֵ֨/הוּ עִמָּ֜/הּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר גְּמָלַ֗תּ/וּ בְּ/פָרִ֤ים שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ וְ/אֵיפָ֨ה אַחַ֥ת קֶ֨מַח֙ וְ/נֵ֣בֶל יַ֔יִן וַ/תְּבִאֵ֥/הוּ בֵית יְהוָ֖ה שִׁל֑וֹ וְ/הַ/נַּ֖עַר נָֽעַר־׃

context.marker_free_english: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, one ephah of flour, and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of Yahweh at Shiloh. Now the boy was young.

source.text: וַֽ/יִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ אֶת הַ/פָּ֑ר וַ/יָּבִ֥יאוּ אֶת הַ/נַּ֖עַר אֶל עֵלִֽי־־־׃

context.marker_free_english: Then they slaughtered the bull and brought the boy to Eli.

source.text: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔/י חֵ֥י נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ אֲדֹנִ֑/י אֲנִ֣י הָ/אִשָּׁ֗ה הַ/נִּצֶּ֤בֶת עִמְּ/כָה֙ בָּ/זֶ֔ה לְ/הִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל יְהוָֽה־׃

context.marker_free_english: And she said, “Please, my lord, as surely as you live, my lord, I am the woman who stood here beside you, praying to Yahweh.

source.text: אֶל הַ/נַּ֥עַר הַ/זֶּ֖ה הִתְפַּלָּ֑לְתִּי וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה לִ/י֙ אֶת שְׁאֵ֣לָתִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁאַ֖לְתִּי מֵ/עִמּֽ/וֹ־־׃

context.marker_free_english: For this boy I prayed, and Yahweh has given me my petition that I asked from him.

source.text: וְ/גַ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י הִשְׁאִלְתִּ֨/הוּ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה כָּל הַ/יָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֔ה ה֥וּא שָׁא֖וּל לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ שָׁ֖ם לַ/יהוָֽה־׃פ

context.marker_free_english: So I also have given him to Yahweh; all the days that he lives, he is given to Yahweh.” And he worshiped Yahweh there.
